contexts.text: The sensuous things which are subordinate to the intellectual part are represented by the butler of the king of Egypt... That these are retained is represented by the butler being restored to his post.

The butler of the king of Egypt () = with those things in the body which are subject to the intellectual part. A butler = the external Sensual, or Sensual of the body which is subordinate or subject to the intellectual part of the internal man. Explained. AC 5082. AC 5094. AC 5128. AC 5163. AC 5227.
The butler and the baker represent the Lord as to those things which are of the external Natural. AC 5118.
The prince of the cupbearers = the Sensual subject to the intellectual part in general, and which heretofore has been rejected.
He brought back the prince of the cupbearers upon his pledging = that the sensuous things of the intellectual part were received and subordinated. Explained.
A butler = the truth of doctrine.
